explanation: eta electroproduction threshold is W_th = m_p + m_eta = 0.938272 + 0.54786 = 1.486132 GeV. The requested W = 1.52 GeV is about 34 MeV above threshold, comfortably in the physical region, and cos(theta*) = -0.4 is a valid CM-angle value at any W above threshold (no boundary issue). Q2 = 0.6 GeV^2 and W = 1.52 GeV are both well inside the EtaMAID-2023 table grid (Q2 = 0-5 GeV^2, W = 1.4856-6 GeV) used by mpintp.inc, so the interpolation is not extrapolating. At the default CLAS12 beam momentum (bmom = 6.53 GeV), the energy transfer needed (nu ~= 1.08 GeV) and Q2 = 0.6 GeV^2 are far from the beam-energy/angle kinematic limits, so the point is also reachable electron-kinematically. No corrections were needed; generated a single-point eta-channel input file (model=3 maid2000, ivec=1 recoil proton, vcut=0.166 GeV^2 CLAS12 inelasticity cut, rc_mode=0 full O(alpha) corrections) following the format in README.md/examples/README.md.
